024public class CheapCommodityMission extends HubMissionWithBarEvent {
025
026        public static boolean SAME_CONTACT_DEBUG = false;
027        
028        public static float MISSION_DAYS = 120f;
029        
030        public static float MIN_BASE_VALUE = 30000;
031        public static float MAX_BASE_VALUE = 100000;
032        public static float BASE_PRICE_MULT = 0.33f;
033        
034        public static float PROB_REMOTE = 0.5f;
035        
036        public static float PROB_BAR_UNDERWORLD = 0.25f;
037        public static float PROB_ILLEGAL_IF_UNDERWORLD = 0.75f;
038        public static float ILLEGAL_QUANTITY_MULT = 0.5f;
039        
040        
041        public static enum Stage {
042                TALK_TO_PERSON,
043                COMPLETED,
044                FAILED,
045        }
046        public static enum Variation {
047                LOCAL,
048                REMOTE,
049        }
050        
051        protected String commodityId;
052        protected int quantity;
053        protected int pricePerUnit;
054        
055        protected Variation variation;
056        protected MarketAPI remoteMarket;
057        protected PersonAPI remoteContact;
058        
059        
060        @Override
061        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
062                if (barEvent) {
063                        if (rollProbability(PROB_BAR_UNDERWORLD)) {
064                                setGiverRank(Ranks.CITIZEN);
065                                setGiverPost(pickOne(Ranks.POST_SMUGGLER, Ranks.POST_GANGSTER, 
066                                                                         Ranks.POST_FENCE, Ranks.POST_CRIMINAL));
067                                setGiverImportance(pickImportance());
068                                setGiverFaction(Factions.PIRATES);
069                                setGiverTags(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD);
070                        } else {
071                                setGiverRank(Ranks.CITIZEN);
072                                setGiverPost(pickOne(Ranks.POST_TRADER, Ranks.POST_COMMODITIES_AGENT, 
073                                                                         Ranks.POST_MERCHANT, Ranks.POST_INVESTOR, Ranks.POST_PORTMASTER));
074                                setGiverImportance(pickImportance());
075                                setGiverTags(Tags.CONTACT_TRADE);
076                        }
077                        findOrCreateGiver(createdAt, false, false);
078                }
079                
080                PersonAPI person = getPerson();
081                if (person == null) return false;
082                MarketAPI market = person.getMarket();
083                if (market == null) return false;
084                
085                if (!setPersonMissionRef(person, "$cheapCom_ref")) {
086                        return false;
087                }
088                
089                if (barEvent) {
090                        setGiverIsPotentialContactOnSuccess();
091                }
092                
093                PersonImportance importance = person.getImportance();
094                boolean canOfferRemote = importance.ordinal() >= PersonImportance.MEDIUM.ordinal();
095                boolean preferExpensive = getQuality() >= PersonImportance.HIGH.getValue();
096                variation = Variation.LOCAL;
097                if (canOfferRemote && rollProbability(PROB_REMOTE)) {
098                        variation = Variation.REMOTE;
099                }
100                if (SAME_CONTACT_DEBUG) variation = Variation.REMOTE;
101
102                CommodityOnMarketAPI com = null;
103                if (variation == Variation.LOCAL) {
104                        requireMarketIs(market);
105                        requireCommodityIsNotPersonnel();
106                        requireCommodityDeficitAtMost(0);
107                        requireCommodityAvailableAtLeast(1);
108                        requireCommoditySurplusAtLeast(1);
109                        if (person.hasTag(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD) && rollProbability(PROB_ILLEGAL_IF_UNDERWORLD)) {
110                                preferCommodityIllegal();
111                        } else {
112                                requireCommodityLegal();
113                        }
114                        if (preferExpensive) {
115                                preferCommodityTags(ReqMode.ALL, Commodities.TAG_EXPENSIVE);
116                        }
117                        com = pickCommodity();
118                } 
119                
120                if (com == null && canOfferRemote) {
121                        variation = Variation.REMOTE;
122                }
123                
124                
125                if (variation == Variation.REMOTE) {
126                        requireMarketIsNot(market);
127                        requireMarketFaction(market.getFactionId());
128                        if (SAME_CONTACT_DEBUG) {
129                                requireMarketIs("jangala");
130                        }
131                        requireCommodityIsNotPersonnel();
132                        requireCommodityDeficitAtMost(0);
133                        requireCommodityAvailableAtLeast(1);
134                        requireCommoditySurplusAtLeast(1);
135                        preferMarketInDirectionOfOtherMissions();
136                        if (person.hasTag(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD) && rollProbability(PROB_ILLEGAL_IF_UNDERWORLD)) {
137                                preferCommodityIllegal();
138                        } else {
139                                requireMarketFactionNotHostileTo(Factions.PLAYER);
140                                requireCommodityLegal();
141                        }
142                        if (preferExpensive) {
143                                preferCommodityTags(ReqMode.ALL, Commodities.TAG_EXPENSIVE);
144                        }
145                        com = pickCommodity();
146                        if (com != null) remoteMarket = com.getMarket();
147                }
148                
149                if (SAME_CONTACT_DEBUG) {
150                        com = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("jangala").getCommodityData(Commodities.ORGANICS);
151                        remoteMarket = com.getMarket();
152                }
153                
154                if (com == null) return false;
155                
156                commodityId = com.getId();
157                
158                float value = MIN_BASE_VALUE + (MAX_BASE_VALUE - MIN_BASE_VALUE) * getQuality();
159                quantity = getRoundNumber(value / com.getCommodity().getBasePrice());
160                if (com.isIllegal()) {
161                        quantity *= ILLEGAL_QUANTITY_MULT;
162                }
163                
164                if (quantity < 10) quantity = 10;
165                pricePerUnit = (int) (com.getMarket().getSupplyPrice(com.getId(), quantity, true) / (float) quantity * 
166                                                          BASE_PRICE_MULT / getRewardMult());
167                pricePerUnit = getRoundNumber(pricePerUnit);
168                if (pricePerUnit < 2) pricePerUnit = 2;
169                
170                
171                if (variation == Variation.REMOTE) {
172                        remoteContact = findOrCreateTrader(remoteMarket.getFactionId(), remoteMarket, true);
173                        //person = findOrCreateCriminal(market, true);
174                        if (remoteContact == null || !setPersonMissionRef(remoteContact, "$cheapCom_ref")) {
175                                return false;
176                        }
177                        setPersonDoGenericPortAuthorityCheck(remoteContact);
178                        makeImportant(remoteContact, "$cheapCom_hasCommodity", Stage.TALK_TO_PERSON);
179                        
180                        setStartingStage(Stage.TALK_TO_PERSON);
181                        setSuccessStage(Stage.COMPLETED);
182                        setFailureStage(Stage.FAILED);
183                        
184                        setStageOnMemoryFlag(Stage.COMPLETED, remoteContact, "$cheapCom_completed");
185                        setTimeLimit(Stage.FAILED, MISSION_DAYS, null);
186                        
187                }
188                
189                if (getQuality() < 0.5f) {
190                        setRepFactionChangesVeryLow();
191                } else {
192                        setRepFactionChangesLow();
193                }
194                setRepPersonChangesMedium();
195                
196                return true;
197        }
198        
199        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
200                set("$cheapCom_ref2", this);
201                
202                set("$cheapCom_barEvent", isBarEvent());
203                set("$cheapCom_underworld", getPerson().hasTag(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD));
204                
205                set("$cheapCom_commodityId", commodityId);
206                set("$cheapCom_commodityName", getSpec().getLowerCaseName());
207                set("$cheapCom_quantity", Misc.getWithDGS(quantity));
208                set("$cheapCom_pricePerUnit", Misc.getDGSCredits(pricePerUnit));
209                set("$cheapCom_totalPrice", Misc.getDGSCredits(pricePerUnit * quantity));
210                set("$cheapCom_variation", variation);
211                set("$cheapCom_manOrWoman", getPerson().getManOrWoman());
212                
213                //set("$cheapCom_heOrShe", getPerson().getHeOrShe());
214                //set("$cheapCom_HeOrShe", getPerson().getHeOrShe().substring(0, 1).toUpperCase() + getPerson().getHeOrShe().substring(1));
215                
216                //set("$cheapCom_manOrWoman", getPerson().getManOrWoman());
217                
218                if (variation == Variation.REMOTE) {
219                        set("$cheapCom_personName", remoteContact.getNameString());
220                        set("$cheapCom_personPost", remoteContact.getPost().toLowerCase());
221                        set("$cheapCom_marketName", remoteMarket.getName());
222                        set("$cheapCom_marketOnOrAt", remoteMarket.getOnOrAt());
223                        set("$cheapCom_dist", getDistanceLY(remoteMarket));
224                }
225        }
226        
227        @Override
228        public void addDescriptionForNonEndStage(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
229                float opad = 10f;
230                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
231                if (currentStage == Stage.TALK_TO_PERSON) {
232                        TooltipMakerAPI text = info.beginImageWithText(remoteContact.getPortraitSprite(), 48f);
233                        text.addPara("Go to " + remoteMarket.getName() + " and contact " + remoteContact.getNameString() + " to pick up %s units of " + 
234                                        getSpec().getLowerCaseName() + " " +
235                                        "for %s per unit, or %s total.",
236                                        0f, h,
237                                        Misc.getWithDGS(quantity),
238                                        Misc.getDGSCredits(pricePerUnit), 
239                                        Misc.getDGSCredits(pricePerUnit * quantity));
240                        info.addImageWithText(opad);
241                }
242        }
243
244        @Override
245        public boolean addNextStepText(TooltipMakerAPI info, Color tc, float pad) {
246                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
247                if (currentStage == Stage.TALK_TO_PERSON) {
248                        info.addPara("Go to " + remoteMarket.getName() + " and contact " + remoteContact.getNameString() + " to arrange pickup", tc, pad);
249                        return true;
250                }
251                return false;
252        }

258        @Override
259        public String getBaseName() {
260                return getSpec().getName() + " Pickup";
261        }
262        
263        @Override
264        public void accept(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
265                if (variation == Variation.REMOTE) {
266                        super.accept(dialog, memoryMap);
267                        
268                        // papering over a bug for a hotfix - apparently it's possible
269                        // for the remote contact to be removed from the comm directory
270                        // should be fixed by -RC9, though; possibly save is from RC8
271                        if (remoteMarket != null && remoteMarket.getCommDirectory() != null && 
272                                        remoteMarket.getCommDirectory().getEntryForPerson(remoteContact) == null) {
273                                remoteMarket.getCommDirectory().addPerson(remoteContact);
274                        }
275                } else {
276                        // if it's the local variation, there's no intel item and the commodity/credits etc is handled
277                        // in the rules csv. Need to abort here, though, so that mission ref is unset from person memory
278                        
279                        currentStage = new Object(); // so that the abort() assumes the mission was successful
280                        abort();
281                }
282        }

286                if (spec == null) {
287                        spec = Global.getSettings().getCommoditySpec(commodityId);
288                }
289                return spec;
290        }
